turns.text: Welcome, Mr. Billjuke.
turns.zh: 欢迎，Billjuke先生。

turns.text: Today, I will be conducting your monthly performance review.
turns.zh: 今天，我将对你进行月度绩效评估。

turns.text: This review can take anywhere from two to six hours,
turns.zh: 这次评估可能需要两到六个小时，

turns.text: depending on the number of atolments and approbations required.
turns.zh: 取决于需要多少调整和批准。

turns.text: If the review is to take longer than four hours,
turns.zh: 如果评估超过四个小时，

turns.text: there will be a break for lunch with the order taken in advance.
turns.zh: 中间会休息吃午饭，菜单会提前点好。

turns.text: Well, I hope that won't be necessary.
turns.zh: 嗯，我希望没必要那么久。

turns.text: Here is the lunch menu. [soft music]
turns.zh: 这是午餐菜单。[轻音乐]

turns.text: Let's start with the positives.
turns.zh: 我们先从好的方面开始。

turns.text: You received the gift of Kiehr paintings with grace.
turns.zh: 你优雅地接受了Kiehr画作这份礼物。

turns.text: Your attendance and your analysis are both in the excellent range. - Wonderful. of Kiehr paintings with grace. Your attendance and your analysis
turns.zh: 你的出勤和分析都在优秀范围内。— 太好了。优雅地接受了Kiehr画作这份礼物。你的出勤和分析

turns.text: are both in the excellent range. Wonderful.
turns.zh: 都在优秀范围内。太好了。

turns.text: Alternatively, and sadly, there have been three contentions
turns.zh: 另外，遗憾的是，有三项投诉

turns.text: reported anonymously, which have been investigated and confirmed. Oh?
turns.zh: 是匿名举报的，已经调查并确认了。哦？

turns.text: One, uses too many big words.
turns.zh: 第一，用太多大词了。

turns.text: Well, for a chance, I may colloquially employ...
turns.zh: 嗯，偶尔我可能会口语化地用……

turns.text: Anti-deflections will be heard after the lunch break.
turns.zh: 午休后会听取反 deflection 意见。

turns.text: Yes, sorry.
turns.zh: 是的，抱歉。

turns.text: Two, on several of your daily logs,
turns.zh: 第二，在你的几份日常日志上，

turns.text: the paperclip was installed back to front,
turns.zh: 回形针装反了，

turns.text: which led to a confusion as to where in the document to begin reading.
turns.zh: 导致搞不清该从文档哪里开始读。

turns.text: Here are the incidents.
turns.zh: 这些是事件记录。

turns.text: But the bulk of our day will revolve around the following.
turns.zh: 但我们今天大部分时间会围绕以下内容。

turns.text: You brought in a new refining team for Mark S,
turns.zh: 你给Mark S引进了一个新的精炼团队，

turns.text: which failed to coalesce.
turns.zh: 但团队没能凝聚起来。

turns.text: You instituted kindness reforms.
turns.zh: 你推行了善意改革。

turns.text: Because I'm not Harmony Cobell.
turns.zh: 因为我不是Harmony Cobell。

turns.text: Kindness reforms. Because I'm not Harmony Cobell. Kindness reforms.
turns.zh: 善意改革。因为我不是Harmony Cobell。善意改革。

turns.text: It seemed to have in no way deterred curiosity or idling
turns.zh: 这似乎丝毫没有阻止团队的好奇心或偷懒

turns.text: by the team once they returned.
turns.zh: 他们回来后。

turns.text: You arranged an outdoor retreat
turns.zh: 你安排了一次户外团建

turns.text: in team-building occurrence,
turns.zh: 作为团队建设活动，

turns.text: which resulted in the termination of one employee
turns.zh: 结果导致一名员工被解雇

turns.text: and the discovery of the true identity of another
turns.zh: 以及另一名员工的真实身份被发现

turns.text: at great risk and harm to the Egan name.
turns.zh: 给Egan家族的名声带来了巨大风险和损害。

turns.text: ♪ - Look, Seth.
turns.zh: ♪ — 听着，Seth。

turns.text: Mark Scout's completion of Cold Harbor
turns.zh: Mark Scout完成Cold Harbor

turns.text: will be remembered as one of the greatest moments
turns.zh: 将被铭记为这个星球历史上

turns.text: in the history of this planet.
turns.zh: 最伟大的时刻之一。

turns.text: It will take place under your stewardship.
turns.zh: 这将在你的管理下发生。

turns.text: It's quite a legacy, you believe.
turns.zh: 这是一份相当大的遗产，你相信吧。

turns.text: - Thank you, Mr. Drummond.
turns.zh: — 谢谢您，Drummond先生。

turns.text: That means a great deal.
turns.zh: 这对我意义重大。

turns.text: This milestone seems to have clouded your judgment.
turns.zh: 这个里程碑似乎蒙蔽了你的判断力。

turns.text: I think it's time to go back to the basics, Seth.
turns.zh: 我觉得是时候回归基本了，Seth。

turns.text: To remember these severed workers' greater purpose.
turns.zh: 记住这些分离工人的更大目标。

turns.text: greater purpose and to treat them as what they really are. ♪♪ ♪♪
turns.zh: 更大目标，并把他们当作他们真正是什么来对待。♪♪ ♪♪

turns.text: Sir?
turns.zh: 先生？

turns.text: Have a seat.
turns.zh: 坐下。

turns.text: I heard my performance review yesterday.
turns.zh: 我昨天听到了我的绩效评估。

turns.text: How did it go? Many valid concerns were raised, which I look forward to addressing.
turns.zh: 怎么样？提出了许多合理的关切，我期待着手解决。

turns.text: I'm glad for you.
turns.zh: 我为你高兴。

turns.text: I feel I should remind you, you cannot graduate from this fellowship
turns.zh: 我觉得我应该提醒你，你不能从这个研究员项目毕业

turns.text: until I have deemed you winter-tied material.
turns.zh: 直到我认为你是冬 ties 材料。

turns.text: This will mean using your time well,
turns.zh: 这意味着要好好利用你的时间，

turns.text: focusing on your own duties,
turns.zh: 专注于你自己的职责，

turns.text: and eradicating from your essence childish folly.
turns.zh: 并从你的本质中根除幼稚的愚蠢。

turns.text: I understand, sir.
turns.zh: 我明白，先生。

turns.text: I shall be busy for the rest of the day.
turns.zh: 我今天剩下的时间会很忙。

turns.text: I trust you can stew it, the floor in my stead?
turns.zh: 我相信你能替我盯着这里？

turns.text: Of course.
turns.zh: 当然。

turns.text: Good. You may sit at your regular desk.
turns.zh: 好。你可以坐在你平时的办公桌。

turns.text: You may sit at your regular desk.
turns.zh: 你可以坐在你平时的办公桌。

turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Milchik. [
turns.zh: 谢谢您，Milchik先生。[
